summary: Verified the Sep 10 2026 SFG-shortage change end-to-end without triggering any live SAP write. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_sfg_shortage_allowed_flag.py (9 tests, all passing in 1.52s) that seeds synthetic jobs directly into the `background_jobs` collection for all 4 required scenarios (SFG-only, BOP-only, both short, no shortage) and hits GET /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order/status/{job_id} through the preview URL. Confirms: (a) `sfg_shortage` persists on the job doc through terminal `status=done`, (b) SFG-only shortage does NOT create `store_request_id` and does NOT pause at `waiting_store_approval`, (c) BOP-only shortage still creates a real `store_request_id` and pauses at `waiting_store_approval` with `sfg_shortage` absent, (d) both-short scenario stores `sfg_shortage` AND `store_request_id` AND pauses at `waiting_store_approval` (coexistence), (e) normal no-shortage completes cleanly with neither flag. Two static source-code guards prove the old blocking path is gone: no `"reason": "sfg_shortage"` literal remains in server.py and the `if short_sfg:` block writes only the flag with NO early-return (falls through to Proposal creation). API surface tests confirm 404 for unknown job_id and 401 without auth. Frontend: seeded a `production_confirmation` super_admin session + 2 synthetic jobs (one SFG-only done, one both-short waiting_store_approval), primed `localStorage.productionConfirmationActiveJobs`, reloaded /production-confirmation. UI verified: `active-order-sfg-shortage-flag-0` amber Badge reading exactly 'SFG Shortage - Allowed with flag' rendered ALONGSIDE the normal 'Waiting for Store' status badge (both visible in the same status cell - flag does NOT replace the primary status), and the persistent detail row `active-order-sfg-shortage-0` rendered in amber (#FFFAEB bg, #B54708 text, #FEDF89 border - non-error styling) with per-component rows (product_id, required qty, available qty in {site_id}-SFG, short-by qty) for both TEST_SFG_A (25 req / 4 avail / 21 short) and TEST_SFG_B (10 req / 0 avail / 10 short) via `active-order-sfg-shortage-row-0-*` selectors. Screenshot: /app/.screenshots/sfg_shortage_ui.png. No live end-to-end SAP order was created (this is a live tenant per instructions); shape of the flag + branching logic were proven via seeded state + source-code inspection instead.
critical_code_review_comments: Branching in server.py `_run_create_and_release_job` is clean and correct - `short_sfg` writes the flag then falls through, `short_rm` still creates the Store Approval request and returns early to pause. No dead-code remnant of the old blocking path was left behind.

Frontend `pollJob` correctly merges `job.sfg_shortage` into local state as `sfgShortage` on BOTH the PAUSED_STATUSES and the normal branches, so the flag stays visible whether the job is paused for BOP Store approval or streaming through creating_proposal->done.

Preview backend is presently overloaded by background SAP jobs (bom_cache refresh + sap_valuation retries hitting connect timeouts against my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap). This is pre-existing, NOT caused by this change, but it did make live API calls sporadically 30-120s slow during testing - a `backend` restart via supervisor cleared it. Not a regression for this task; flag it separately if the user has been seeing intermittent slowness.
test_credentials: Synthetic super_admin session (production_confirmation page perm) - all seed data was cleaned up after testing (auth_users, auth_sessions and background_jobs docs for _id starting with 'test-tid:iter154-*').
seed_data_creation: All synthetic data was cleaned up after testing (auth_users, auth_sessions, background_jobs). Nothing left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The SFG-shortage 'allowed with flag' change (Sep 10 2026) is fully verified via seeded state - no real live SAP end-to-end order was run (live production tenant). If a future testing agent wants to prove it with a REAL live run, /production-confirmation/bom-stock-status or /production-confirmation/open-lots can be used to find a currently-short material, but be judicious with SAP writes. Use collection name `background_jobs` (NOT `production_confirmation_jobs`) when seeding job_store docs directly - the correct collection name comes from `job_store.py` constant COLLECTION_NAME.
rca of the issue: N/A - additive feature change, verified working as designed.
